title: Oracle origin walk
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, $f:\bbz\to\mathrm{Option}(\{0,1\})$, $p\in\bbz$, a Boolean side satisfying $p\ge0$ when the side is true and $p\le0$ otherwise, an input-head position, and an output word. For every $u\le |p|$, running the oracle-dispatch machine for $u$ steps from the marked configuration yields the walk configuration based on that marked configuration, in state corresponding to the same origin side, with the first two head positions equal to $p + d u$, where $d=-1$ for true side and $d=1$ for false side.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head position for $x$ is given
